bug_semantics: An authenticated bot author can store a rich-text link with a javascript: URL. Typebot serializes that author-controlled link and presents it to a visitor as active HTML or, in later viewers, assigns the stored URL directly to an anchor href without validating its protocol. A victim click executes attacker JavaScript in the viewer or embedding host page origin; target="_blank" and rel="noopener noreferrer" do not neutralize a javascript: URL. The assigned advisory snapshot records @typebot.io/js versions below 0.10.1 as vulnerable and 0.10.1 as first patched, and the first-party advisory metadata identifies application versions through 3.15.2 as affected and 3.16.0 as patched.
flaw_origin: The reviewer is correct and the primary is wrong about both disputed fields. The smallest repository commit that first creates the complete stored-link source-to-sink path is b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3, whose sole immediate parent is a54e42f255ac791251baf582e4925c7c58246603. That commit directly adds createLinkPlugin and LinkToolbarButton, serializes editor nodes into content.html, and adds HostMessageBubble.tsx with dangerouslySetInnerHTML of that stored HTML, without URL-protocol validation. Its parent has none of createLinkPlugin, LinkToolbarButton, serializeHtml, or dangerouslySetInnerHTML under apps or packages. It is an ordinary one-parent first-writer, not a move, import, merge, or later squash carrier. The primary candidate 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 only adds a new Solid viewer carrier using innerHTML={props.content.html}; its direct parent e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6 already contains the vulnerable link-authoring, serialization, and React bot-engine rendering path, and b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 is an ancestor of that parent.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 shows one parent, human author and committer Baptiste Arnaud <contact@baptiste-arnaud.fr>, and only the subject '🚀 Init preview and typebot cotext in editor'; the BIC commit object has no AI identity, bot identity, Co-authored-by trailer, Generated-with trailer, or other AI attribution. AI attribution on the 2026 fix object is later and is not BIC evidence.
evidence: The assigned advisory snapshot identifies the vulnerable PlateBlock.tsx href, the stored javascript: link and victim-click mechanism, @typebot.io/js <0.10.1, and 0.10.1 as first patched. For the introducer_sha and introducer_parent disagreement, git show --format=fuller b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 over TextEditor.tsx, ToolBar.tsx, plate.ts, and HostMessageBubble.tsx shows new-file additions of createLinkPlugin, LinkToolbarButton, serializeHtml into content.html, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML from step.content.html. git cat-file -p b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 names exactly one parent, a54e42f255ac791251baf582e4925c7c58246603. git grep at that direct parent for 'dangerouslySetInnerHTML|serializeHtml|LinkToolbarButton|createLinkPlugin' under apps and packages returns no matches, while git log --all --reverse -S'LinkToolbarButton' starts at b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3. Conversely, git cat-file -p 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 names e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6 as its parent, and git grep at that parent finds the existing builder LinkToolbarButton/serializeHtml path and packages/bot-engine TextBubble.tsx dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink. git show of that parent file confirms block.content.html is inserted into the bubble. git merge-base --is-ancestor b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 e55823e0112291a32886908fd4c63365275106e6 succeeds, proving the primary's candidate is a later carrier rather than the first writer. For the fix gate, git show 2c3fc7267a5e1529ba4b1a2ab4f1edb3e3b8990b shows PlateBlock href changed to sanitizeUrl and the new utility allowlisting http:, https:, mailto:, and tel: while mapping other or invalid URLs to '#'. The fix parent package manifest is version 0.10.0 and the fix tree is 0.10.1. v3.15.2 resolves to 3e921b23017d66c87cfcd0283e027b8c220fc451 and still has the raw href; v3.16.0 resolves to 7bc1a6f856f64c5ae38ecb6eb87a175b0a50c5c1 and uses sanitizeUrl. git merge-base --is-ancestor confirms the fix is absent from v3.15.2 and present in v3.16.0.
reasoning: The disagreement cannot be resolved by choosing the commit that first introduced the current filename or package. The security flaw is the missing protocol validation across the stored author-link lifecycle. b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 is causally earlier and smaller in the relevant sense: it is the single commit that first writes both the authoring/serialization source and an executable HTML sink, and its direct parent lacks that path. Although it is a broad feature commit, the object directly adds the vulnerable code and has one parent; no smaller decomposed source object is evidenced, so it is not rejected as an aggregate, import, or move. By contrast, 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 adds another viewer implementation after its parent already has the same author-controlled stored HTML flowing to a clickable browser sink. Thus the reviewer wins introducer_sha=b7cdc0d14a83891786507f6cdf76339b320461c3 and introducer_parent=a54e42f255ac791251baf582e4925c7c58246603, while the primary's later Solid carrier and its parent are not the BIC boundary. The direct fix closes the protocol-validation invariant and is present at both declared patched boundaries. Because only the verified BIC commit object controls attribution and that object has no AI signal, the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
